fullDescription: A single ANIMATED WEBGL SHADER: God Rays, transmittance marched outward in polar space. Twenty samples are marched from a source toward each pixel, accumulating how much light gets THROUGH an occluder rather than how much is blocked, with the occluder sampled at high frequency across angle and low across radius. It is a full-bleed fragment shader with no page around it, about 4KB, no textures, no images and no animation library, and it reacts to the pointer. Drop it behind a hero, a section or a whole page as a living background. Under prefers-reduced-motion it renders one static frame, and it falls back cleanly where WebGL is absent.
prompt:
## Resumo
A full-viewport animated WebGL fragment shader called God Rays: transmittance marched outward in polar space. Twenty samples are marched from a source toward each pixel, accumulating how much light gets THROUGH an occluder rather than how much is blocked, with the occluder sampled at high frequency across angle and low across radius. The page contains nothing but the canvas. A shared GLSL preamble provides a hashed value noise, a six-octave fbm and a two-level domain-warp helper; this effect draws on them and adds its own body. Pointer movement raises a smoothed intensity uniform so the effect strengthens under the cursor and relaxes when it leaves.

## Estilo Visual
Ground #07070A with accents ["#FF9438", "#2A0F04"]. There is no typography and no page chrome: the shader is the entire surface. Keep the palette to two or three values so the effect reads as one material rather than a rainbow.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Canvas
One canvas fixed at inset 0 filling the viewport, with html and body at 100 percent height, margin 0 and overflow hidden. Behind it a hidden panel that is only shown when no WebGL context can be created.

### The shader
Transmittance marched outward in polar space. Twenty samples are marched from a source toward each pixel, accumulating how much light gets THROUGH an occluder rather than how much is blocked, with the occluder sampled at high frequency across angle and low across radius.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Full-bleed fragment shader with no surrounding page

### Componente
Smoothed pointer-intensity uniform

### Componente
No-WebGL fallback panel

### Componente
Reduced-motion single-frame path
